$comment: Alerts-as-record for org kenyonexpress / project kenyonexpress-web (region de.sentry.io). The MCP surface exposes find/get for alert rules but no create/update, and no SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN exists in any environment here, so rules beyond the two 'live' entries below are DESIRED state to be created in the Sentry UI. When one is created, move it to live with its id.

live.name: Send a notification for high priority issues
API Health
live.createdVia: Sentry MCP, this repo's ops work

desired.name: Error rate above 5% for 15m
desired.why: the tripwire for a bad deploy

desired.name: INVALID_TRANSITION in payments
desired.why: the payment state machine refusing means money and state disagree

desired.name: Webhook BAD_SIGNATURE 3 in 10m
desired.why: one is a typo, three is someone probing the Cardcom callback

desired.name: Cron route failures
desired.why: the scheduler is best-effort; a failing handler must not be silent (ntfy covers the pager path already via lib/observability/alert.ts)

notes: The pager path that needs no Sentry at all is src/lib/observability/alert.ts -> ntfy.sh/kenyon-ofir-limit: no handshake, no dependency that can break the alert about the thing that broke. Sentry rules are the queryable layer on top, not the only wire.
